answer: Every proof carries its date, so a proof painted yesterday cannot pretend to be a year old. The farm counts its prism as a win, its shale as an expense, its pearl as a nuisance — and the nuisance is the one it cannot buy off. No mask rides free: 143 POA and 29 minutes apiece, which is 21593 POA and 4379 minutes for 151. One proof settles it, and it reads Meal packer sorghum meal milled at the sifting loft, spelled out in full as each sorghum is a milling record witnessed by the toll keeper. The record forgets nothing and the price bends for no one; the farm loses on both counts.
